label: Species-unresolved decorative roadside shade tree

materials.inputs: Original geometry; constant PBR values and authored procedural bark only
materials.base_color: Linear values in manifest and Blender; future colour maps use sRGB
materials.roughness_metallic_normal: Future data maps use Non-Color; no such maps supplied
materials.bark: Dielectric, roughness .88; procedural preview ridges do not survive FBX
materials.leaves: Opaque closed thin laminae, metallic 0, roughness .64; no alpha cards
materials.unreal: Rebuild constant material slots. Optional Two Sided Foliage shading needs native visual review; no wind/botanical shader supplied

ground_contact: root origin at soil Z=0, root flare embeds below zero

coordinate_contract.source: Blender Z-up metres, matrices row-major; no geographic placement
coordinate_contract.fbx: Standard Blender -Y forward/Z up, metre scene units, FBX_SCALE_UNITS
coordinate_contract.ue_explicit: For existing Baddie source basis only: UE cm=100*(Blender y,x,z), matrix C*M*C^-1
coordinate_contract.import_warning: Explicit matrices are not FBX importer defaults. Native writer must verify axis/units/pivots on import; never apply both conversions

instance_strategy: One bark mesh plus HISM per six cluster mesh variants. Combine only after explicit target performance/visual review
visual_acceptance: Pending actual rendered branch junction, leaf scale, gaps, contact shadow and native import review
limitations: Original decorative geometry, not botanically or geographically verified
Overlapping branch grafts, not one watertight trunk mesh
No wind rig, baked maps, collision, native shader or native performance measurement
Distant detail reduces real leaves only when explicitly selected, not the default city asset
